# GitHub Copilot Instructions — SMA-app

See [DEVELOPMENT_RULES.md](../DEVELOPMENT_RULES.md) — single source of truth for this project's governance, workflow, and technical conventions.

Read **Chapter 0-9** in full before writing or changing any code. **Chapter 10** is technical reference (architecture, conventions, recipes): read **C10P1** (the index) always, then open only the C10P2-P9 sections your task actually touches — see **C6P7 (Tiered Reading Rule)**.

This stub exists because Copilot specifically looks for `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. Keeping the real content in one file (`DEVELOPMENT_RULES.md`) avoids drift between this, `CLAUDE.md`, and `.cursor/rules/project.mdc`.
